title: Arrest Of Netherlands Subject - Alfred Krasselt, 47 Years, MCompany Manager, 690 Avenue Road

page_data.en:
R. 22 E.
G. 30m-1-31

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Station Reference No. 322. ARREST REPORT.

CRIME REGISTER No. Arrest of a Netherlands Subject.
(One form to be used for each person arrested)

"B" Division.
Bubblingwell Police Station.
January 30th, 1933.

Name, age, occupation and address of person arrested.
Alfred Krasselt. 47 years, M/Company Manager, 690, Avenue Road.

Arrested by
D.S.I. Widdowson

Date and place where arrest took place.
10.45am, 30-1-33. 690 Avenue Road.

Crime Register No. of offence for which arrested. (If an arrest for outside authorities details of offence for which arrested).
On the 27-1-33, the Commissioner of Police received from the Consul General for the Netherlands, a Warrant, and a request that the one named therein, Alfred Krasselt be arrested, and taken before the said Consul General, who would then transport Krasselt to Java, where he is to face a charge of embezzlement, which he is alleged to have committed on August 23rd 1933. Acting on instructions received from the C of P, the undersigned, accompanied by Mr. Vanderberg of the Netherlands Consulate, arrested Alfred Krasselt, at his home No. 690 Ave Road, at 10.45am, 30-1-33. He was conveyed before the Consul General for the Netherlands, who heard evidence of arrest, and enquired into the circumstances of the charge. Kresselt was then committed to the Amoy Road Gaol, pending such time as his Consul General will find it convenient to transport to Java, Netherlands, Indies.

被逮捕人姓名、年龄、职业及住址。
Alfred Krasselt。47岁，男/公司经理，爱文义路690号。

逮捕人
警署副督察 Widdowson

逮捕日期及地点。
上午10时45分，1933年1月30日。爱文义路690号。

所涉罪行之犯罪登记号。（若系应外部当局要求实施逮捕，需详述被捕罪名）。
1933年1月27日，警务处长收到荷兰总领事签发的逮捕令，并请求逮捕令中指定之人 Alfred Krasselt 予以逮捕，并带至该总领事面前，随后由总领事将 Krasselt 押送至爪哇，以面对一项据称其于1933年8月23日犯下的挪用公款指控。根据警务处长收到的指示，下述签署人会同荷兰领事馆的 Vanderberg 先生，于1933年1月30日上午10时45分，在 Alfred Krasselt 位于爱文义路690号的住所将其逮捕。随后将其带至荷兰总领事面前，总领事听取了关于逮捕情况的陈述，并查问了指控的相关情形。Krasselt 随即被收押于厦门路监狱，等候其总领事认为方便之时，将其押送至荷属东印度群岛的爪哇。

page_data.en:
HHHO

January 27, 33.

Consul-General for Netherlands
Shanghai.

Sir,

I have the honour to acknowledge receipt of
your letter No. 265 dated January 25, forwarding
a warrant for the arrest of ALFRED FRASSELT, and,
in reply, to inform you that the matter is
receiving attention.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

Commissioner of Police.

Original to CP
27/1 PA

HHHO

1933年1月27日。

致
荷兰驻上海总领事

先生：

谨此确认收到阁下1月25日第265号来函，随函附来逮捕 ALFRED FRASSELT 的逮捕令，并复告阁下，此事正在处理中。

谨此致意，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，

警务处长。

原件呈警务处长
1933年1月27日 PA

page_data.en:
CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No. 265.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY.
No. D 4440
27 / 1 / 33

SHANGHAI, 25 January 1933.

Sir,

I have the honour to send you herewith a warrant
for the arrest of the Netherlands subject Alfred
KRASSELT, wanted in Java on account of embezzlement.
In connection with the holidays and as there is no
vessel leaving for Java before Wednesday February
the 1st next, I shall feel obliged if the warrant
is not executed before Monday the 30th inst. It
is not likely that Krasselt will flee, as he is
ignorant of the fact that the warrant has been issued
and besides has no place he could go to. If possible,
a member of the Consulate will accompany the police
to Krasselt's residence, whilst I should appreciate
it if he could be brought to this office before being
lodged in the Amoy Road Gaol.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

〔此处转录不清〕

荷兰驻华中总领事馆
电报挂号 HOLLANDIA。

第265号。

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事侦缉处档案室。
编号 D 4440
1933年1月27日

上海，1933年1月25日。

先生：

谨此随函附上逮捕荷兰籍人士 Alfred KRASSELT 的逮捕令，该人因挪用公款罪在爪哇被通缉。鉴于正值假期，且在下一个星期三（2月1日）之前没有船只驶往爪哇，如能在本月30日（星期一）之前不执行该逮捕令，我将不胜感激。Krasselt 不太可能潜逃，因为他不知道已签发逮捕令这一事实，此外他也无处可去。如有可能，领事馆的一名成员将陪同警察前往 Krasselt 的住所，同时，如果能在将其关入厦门路监狱之前先带至本领馆，我将不胜感激。

谨此致意，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，

〔此处转录不清〕
